source_title: Como Es El Proceso De Compra Internacional
snippet_primary: "En caso de compras internacionales, el sistema identifica la ubicación del comprador y el valor del producto se convertirá automáticamente a la moneda local, Dólar o Euro (dependiendo del país)."
subject_exact: Hotmart international purchase help center (help.hotmart.com/es, as of April 2026) states that for international purchases the system identifies the buyer's location and automatically converts the product price to the buyer's local currency, USD, or EUR depending on the country
local_qualifiers: Hotmart help (as of Apr 2026): international purchases — buyer location auto-detected; price converted to local currency, USD, or EUR by country
